user.title: Connect PV Planner
user.description:
PV Planner reads your PV, grid and battery sensors and derives a solar forecast, the current power surplus and a battery reserve check. It never switches devices itself.

The forecast comes from the free Forecast.Solar service, which needs no API key.

data_description.latitude: Site latitude used for the Forecast.Solar estimate.
data_description.longitude: Site longitude used for the Forecast.Solar estimate.
data_description.declination: Tilt of the panels in degrees from horizontal: 0 is flat, 90 is vertical.
data_description.azimuth: Forecast.Solar convention: 0 is south, -90 is east, 90 is west.
data_description.kwp: Combined peak power of all panels in kWp.
data_description.pv_entity: Sensor with the current total PV power in W or kW.
data_description.grid_entity: Sensor with the signed grid power in W or kW.
data_description.grid_sign: How your grid sensor shows the direction of energy.
data_description.battery_power_entity: Sensor with the signed battery charge and discharge power in W or kW.
data_description.battery_sign: How your battery power sensor shows charging.
data_description.battery_soc_entity: Battery state of charge in percent.
data_description.min_reserve_percent: Share of the battery that must always stay in reserve.
data_description.night_consumption_kwh: Energy the house needs between sunset and sunrise.
data_description.surplus_threshold_w: Minimum surplus power before the surplus binary sensor turns on.

error.invalid_entity: Select a sensor of the required type: power in W or kW for PV, grid and battery power, and a percentage for the battery state of charge.
error.invalid_value: This value is outside the allowed range.

abort.already_configured: PV Planner is already set up. Edit the existing entry instead.

init.title: PV Planner options
init.description: Change the Forecast.Solar site, the source sensors or the reserve calculation. Saving reloads the integration.
